blindSummary: This territory is formally an integral part of a distant metropolitan state, and its law applies directly here, but local conditions diverge sharply from the metropolitan baseline: about 97% of the population belongs to a single faith whose customary religious courts still influence personal-status matters, poverty is deep, and a hostile climate for visible LGBT people is documented. Of the metropolitan state's overseas territories, this one shows the largest local divergence.
blindOutOfScope: Overseas territory of a distant metropolitan state; local divergences noted in summary.
blindSourceSummaries: News outlet feature (Jan 2018): in the metropolitan state, trans women incarcerated on the basis of their legal gender fall into a legal gray area - relevant here because the metropolitan state's law applies directly in this territory.

The metropolitan state's national detention-watchdog opinion of 25 May 2021 on the treatment of transgender persons in places of deprivation of liberty (applicable in this territory): serious violations of fundamental rights persist across all places of detention.

Local news site (May 2016): the metropolitan state's legislature approved simplifying legal gender change under a judicial-modernisation bill - a person may establish before a court that they 'feel themselves to be another sex and that society regards them as such'; the metropolitan procedure applies directly here.

Decriminalisation news site (May 2023): a couple's struggle exposes anti-LGBT bias here - same-sex marriage is legal (still rare in this territory's wider region and among states of the dominant faith), but a gay man's path to marrying his partner from a neighbouring island state was 'long and complicated', illustrating the gap between the metropolitan state's legal rights and lived reality on this predominantly single-faith island.
LGBTQIA+ travel guide entry for this territory (2025 edition): travel and country information for LGBT visitors (page largely navigation content at fetch time).

Directory of LGBT-friendly legal professionals for this territory: no local lawyers yet referenced in the region; the listings are lawyers based in the metropolitan state's capital who defend LGBTQI fundamental liberties.
